VPS Manager Pro (Web SSH Terminal)English | 中文说明

🇬🇧 EnglishVPS Manager Pro is a powerful, web-based SSH terminal that allows you to manage multiple VPS connections from your browser. It features multi-user support, session saving via MySQL, and intelligent detection of proxy configurations (VMess/SOCKS5) directly from the terminal output.
